newsitem.title: INDIA: ACC shuts down old northern India plant.
newsitem.headline: ACC shuts down old northern India plant.

text.p: India's Associated Cement Companies Ltd's (ACC) operations will not be affected by the closure of an old plant, a top official said on Thursday.
"The impact, if at all, will be only favourable," P.K. Sinor, company secretary, told Reuters.
Sinor said the 257,000 tonnes per year capacity plant in the northern Haryana state was shut down since April because limestone deposits, a key raw material, had almost been exhausted in the region.
The plant was set up in 1939, he said.
ACC, India's largest cement maker, has a total capacity to produce about 11 million tonnes annually.
